title: Observed performances of the three systems for removing H₂S gas
markdown:
| No. | Parameter | Inlet | Representative values in the processes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | CH₄ % | 60 to 63 | 64.00 to 70.20 |
| 2 | CO₂ % | 20 to 28 | 20.51 to 27.20 |
| 3 | Hydrogen % | Nil to 2 | Trace to 7.20 |
| 4 | Nitrogen % | 1.3 to 6.4 | 1.1 to 6.8 |
| 5 | Oxygen % | 0.5 to 1.2 | 0.40 to 2.25 |
| 6 | H₂S ppm | 200 to 500 | 10 - 20 ppm |
| 7 | Moisture % | varying | About 50 ppm |
| 8 | Calorific value | 4,400 to 4,800 | 5,500 to 5,800 kcal/nm³ |
notes: Caption prints the chemical formula with a subscript 2: 'H₂S gas'. Cell parameters are likewise printed with subscripts (CH₄ %, CO₂ %, H₂S ppm).
Rows 1 to 5 print no unit in the two value columns; the percent sign appears only in the Parameter column. Nothing was added to the value cells.
Row 7 is headed 'Moisture %' but its process value is printed 'About 50 ppm', a different printed unit label from the percent sign in the row heading. Printed as shown; not corrected.
Row 8 inlet value '4,400 to 4,800' carries no unit, while its process value '5,500 to 5,800 kcal/nm³' does. Nothing was added to the inlet cell.
Row 3 inlet prints the word 'Nil' and its process value prints 'Trace'; both are printed words, not numbers, and are transcribed as words.
Row 6 is the only row whose process value uses a space-hyphen-space range ('10 - 20 ppm'); the other rows print 'to' between the limits. Kept as printed.
No source line or footnote is printed with this table.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full 144 dpi annotation-cleaned page PNGs plus 288-450 dpi detail crops of each item, rotated where the printed table is set sideways; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every printed value, coefficient, power, sign, bracket, spelling and unit retained as printed; source oddities kept and flagged rather than corrected. No distinct second visual pass performed and no verification seal.

visual_recheck.method: Distinct parent comparison of each selected production source-region crop and 216-dpi zoom; no whole-page review; not independent human review.
visual_recheck.observations: Compared every selected header, cell and in-crop footnote. All printed table values match the saved first-reading drafts. Preserved Moisture % / About 50 ppm discrepancy without inferring the kind of concentration.
